properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 17 at 9:40PM EDT until October 18 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Myakka River At Myakka River State Park affecting Sarasota County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Myakka River at Myakka River State Park.

* WHEN...Until Sunday morning.

* IMPACTS...At 7.0 feet, Park Nature Trail floods. Water approaching
porch steps of cabins.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 7.0 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 7.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 9:00 PM EDT Saturday was 7.1 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to fall below flood stage just
after midnight tonight and continue falling to 6.6 feet Tuesday
evening.
- Flood stage is 7.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 7.0
feet on 09/29/1940.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars
through flooded areas.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 800 AM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL SUNDAY MORNING

properties.areaDesc: Gulf of America including Dry Tortugas and Rebecca Shoal Channel
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued October 18 at 2:37AM EDT until October 18 at 3:00AM EDT by NWS Key West FL
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Gulf of America including Dry Tortugas and Rebecca Shoal Channel...

At 237 AM EDT, a possible strong waterspout was located near Pulaski
Shoal Light, moving south at 10 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...National Weather Service Meteorologist.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can quickly form and capsize boats, cause
considerable damage to vessels and create suddenly higher
waves. Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly
higher waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours.

The possible strong waterspout will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally hazardous
seas. Seek safe harbor immediately.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 17 at 8:00PM CDT until October 20 at 7:32PM CDT by NWS Norman OK
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Texas...

Beaver Creek near Electra affecting Wilbarger and Wichita Counties.

For the Beaver Creek (NW TX)...including Electra...Minor flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Beaver Creek near Electra.

* WHEN...From Sunday evening to Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...At 26.0 feet, Flood levels up to 2 feet in depth cover
farm and range lands... and may inundate some oil and gas
facilities... along and near the creek in southern Wilbarger County
and southwestern Wichita County.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 7:00 PM CDT Saturday the stage was 15.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 24.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage late
tomorrow evening to a crest of 25.6 feet early Monday afternoon.
It will then fall below flood stage early Tuesday afternoon.
- Flood stage is 24.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 25.6
feet on 07/28/1991.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued Sunday morning at 800 AM CDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM SUNDAY EVENING TO TUESDAY EVENING

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued October 17 at 8:54PM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

St Johns River Near Astor affecting Lake and Volusia Counties.

.The St Johns River at Astor is forecast to remain in Minor Flood
Stage through Sunday, but strong northeasterly winds will slow river
flow leading to a quick rise in levels. The river is forecast to
reach Moderate Flood Stage early Monday, with a steady increase
through Moderate Flood Stage forecast through the week.

For the St. Johns River...including Astor...Moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring and moderate flooding is
forecast.

* WHERE...St Johns River near Astor.

* WHEN...Until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 3.5 feet, Canals have overflowed into yards. Homes on
or near Wildhog, Bonnet and Snail roads become inaccessible with
several inches of water inside homes along the river and canals.
Docks at Astor Bridge marina and throughout Astor are completely
submerged. Bartram Rd and Holiday Circle are inaccessible with
yards completely submerged. Clair Street is inaccessible. Roads
flooded in South Moon Fish Camp, docks and yards at condominiums on
Juno Trail and water breaches the sea wall at Blair's Jungle Den.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 8:30 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 2.6 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 2.0 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 8:30 PM EDT Saturday was 2.6 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise to 3.3 feet Tuesday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 2.3 feet.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
